purpose: Final executor-development gate for asymmetric previous-h16-chunk gripper reuse.

cohort.scope_label: exposed ACT Object development cohort; not blind/held-out

runtime.success_criterion: LIBERO info is_success, with positive terminal reward as the established fallback

conditions.name: C1_PREVIOUS_CHUNK_GRIP
conditions.grip_source: previous scheduled h16 chunk A_{q-16}[t-q+16,6] after q>=16; current chunk during t<16
conditions.query_rate: same observed rate as hard h16

conditions.name: C2_H16_ARM_FRESH_GRIP
conditions.query_schedule: dense q=t every controller step; scheduled arm chunk still only refreshes at q=0,16,32,...
conditions.query_rate: 1.0 observed when the episode reaches each controller step
conditions.extra_policy_calls: one dense fresh-gripper query at non-multiple steps

baseline_reuse_verification.success_criterion: LIBERO info is_success, with positive terminal reward as the established fallback
verification_evidence: all 126 stored baseline episodes are fresh-environment instances with the frozen seeds
all 126 stored baseline episodes satisfy q=0,16,32,... and q+k=t for both groups
stored baseline aggregate is 88/126, 1490 policy queries, and 22869 environment steps

pairing_smoke.c1_vs_hard_exact_prefix: t=0..15 for initial cameras, processed scheduled-query inputs, scheduled raw chunks, executed actions, and simulator states
pairing_smoke.c1_boundary: t=16 may legitimately change only because the gripper source changes to the previous chunk
pairing_smoke.c2_boundary: C2 may diverge at t=1 because its fresh gripper is queried densely; its arm remains sourced from the scheduled h16 chunk

statistics.age_summary: pooled over executed controller steps, with observed minimum and maximum
statistics.decision_uncertainty_rule: clear positive/negative requires the corresponding bootstrap interval, task-cluster interval, and every leave-one-task-out estimate to have the same strict sign; McNemar is reported but is not the sole decision criterion

decision_rule.ASYM_REUSE_STRONG: Use if ALL are true: C1 success > HARD_H16 success; C1 success > C2 success; paired C1-minus-HARD_H16 net wins > 0; at least 7 of 9 leave-one-task-out C1 - HARD_H16 deltas are positive. McNemar p-values and uncertainty intervals must still be reported, but no single p-value is the sole development gate.
decision_rule.ASYM_REUSE_PROMISING: Use if: C1 > HARD_H16; C1 > C2; paired C1-minus-HARD_H16 net wins > 0; but fewer than 7/9 LOTO deltas are positive. This is still enough to justify ONE frozen cross-suite/unseen confirmation run.
decision_rule.ASYM_REUSE_MECHANISM_ONLY: Use if: C1 <= HARD_H16; but: C1 exceeds C2 by at least 5/126 successes. Interpretation: previous-chunk gripper reuse has a meaningful effect under fixed h16 arm semantics, but it does not improve the strongest standard executor. Stop method development and proceed with a mechanism-focused paper.
decision_rule.ASYM_REUSE_NULL: Use otherwise. In particular, use this if: C1 <= HARD_H16; and C1 does not exceed C2 by at least 5/126. Stop executor development.

decision_uncertainty_rule: clear positive/negative requires the corresponding bootstrap interval, task-cluster interval, and every leave-one-task-out estimate to have the same strict sign; McNemar is reported but is not the sole decision criterion

rollout.task_shards: three simple GPU shards, each owning three primary tasks
